evals.name: bounded-fanout
evals.prompt: Process a slice of 1,000 product IDs concurrently to fetch details from an external API with a max of 10 concurrent requests.
evals.expected_output: Bounded worker pool or errgroup with concurrency limit and context cancellation.
assertions: Concurrency is bounded to exactly 10 active goroutines.
Propagates context for cancellation on first error.
Aggregates results or errors in a thread-safe manner without data races.

evals.name: context-cancellation-cleanup
evals.prompt: A long-running background worker checks a channel and makes periodic API calls. Ensure clean termination on context cancellation.
evals.expected_output: Worker loop with select on ctx.Done() that cleans up resources and exits promptly.
assertions: Selects on ctx.Done() across all blocking channel and timer operations.
Avoids goroutine leaks by terminating when context is canceled.
Releases open resources or buffers in defer blocks.

evals.name: race-safe-state-access
evals.prompt: Implement an in-memory rate limiter tracking hit counts per client IP.
evals.expected_output: Thread-safe data structure using sync.RWMutex or sync.Map with granular lock duration.
assertions: Uses sync.RWMutex with RLock for read checks and Lock for mutations.
Does not hold lock across external I/O or sleep calls.
